measurement: Rigmark interference phase, protocol 2: background decode progress before and during another request's cold prefill

rigmark.note: Local Rigmark extension (--interference-depths) with the review corrections: monotonic timestamps for both window ends, coverage by positive progress after the window, progress-only stalls without edge clipping, raw timelines and hashed salts in the receipts. The standard suites use the unmodified frozen source.

client_transport: direct LAN HTTP to the rank-0 API, same client for every variant
derived_metric: time_lost_seconds = window - tokens_during / decode_tokens_per_second_before: the net time by which a running stream finishes later because of the arriving prefill.
coldness: Each interfering prompt starts with a nonce derived from the comparison ID, depth, decoder count and run; every variant used its own fresh cache salt, whose hash is recorded above.
limitations: One execution of three runs per cell and variant; medians are descriptive.
Raw per-event timelines stay in the private native receipts; this extract keeps the per-stream results and the receipt hashes.
The E22b values in the E27 record were measured with protocol 1 and are not directly comparable.
